test.query: SELECT count(), min(k), max(k) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT number AS k FROM numbers(4000000) ORDER BY k + 1 DESC LIMIT 100000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 65409, max_bytes_before_external_distinct = 33554432

SELECT count(), min(toUInt64(k)), max(toUInt64(k)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT toFixedString(toString(number), 1024) AS k FROM numbers(262144) ORDER BY toUInt64(k) DESC LIMIT 1000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 4096, max_bytes_before_external_distinct = 67108864

SELECT count(), min(toUInt64(k)), max(toUInt64(k)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT toFixedString(toString(number % 131072), 512) AS k FROM numbers(524288) ORDER BY toUInt64(k) DESC LIMIT 20000 OFFSET 7000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 4096, max_bytes_before_external_distinct = 67108864

SELECT count(), min(toUInt64(k)), max(toUInt64(k)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT toFixedString(toString(number), 512) AS k FROM numbers(262144) ORDER BY toUInt64(k) DESC LIMIT 250000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 4096, max_bytes_before_external_distinct = 67108864
